description.text: The first expansion of the Pokémon Card Game MEGA series, made to go with the game Pokémon Legends: Z-A and released on 1 August 2025 together with Mega Brave. Mega Gardevoir ex leads it, a Mega Evolution Pokémon ex that builds up Energy quickly for great damage, and every Pokémon ex in the pair is a Mega Evolution Pokémon ex, giving the opponent three Prize cards when knocked out. Mega Latias ex, which moves between the Active Spot and the Bench as it fights, Mega Kangaskhan ex, whose attack flips coins until tails and grows stronger with each heads, Mega Abomasnow ex, whose attack can do up to 600 damage, and Mega Manectric ex join it, with the Supporters Wally's Compassion, which heals all damage from one of its player's Mega Evolution Pokémon ex, and Acerola's Mischief. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 63, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Trainer cards such as Rare Candy, Special Art Rare cards, and Mega Gardevoir ex as a Mega Ultra Rare, gilded over the whole card. In English most of its cards came out in the Mega Evolution expansion in September 2025, together with Mega Brave's.
